global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with visible bubbles, topped with halved soft-boiled eggs, chashu pork, menma, and nori. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it rests on a dark table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white interior, blue patterned rim, and glossy finish with visible glaze texture.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, golden-brown, rich, slightly frothy surface, thin strands submerged, visible green onions and egg halves nearby.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and rounded, slightly tapered shape.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk surrounded by a pale, translucent white with a smooth, slightly glossy surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, and has a slightly uneven, ridged surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: golden-brown, slightly crispy, rectangular slice with visible fat marbling and tender texture.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, irregularly shaped pieces with a soft, fibrous texture.
